sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.1293 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.-IV, Bhubaneswar arising out of Laxmisagar P.S. Case No.602 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420/506/34 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to implead the informant as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title shall be filed by 18.03.2025 peremptorily.
4. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post with A.D..
5. In the event of non-filing of consolidated cause title by 18.03.2025, as undertaken, the ABLAPL shall stand dismissed without any further reference to the Bench.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
7. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
